DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)

The chest X-ray findings of ground-glass appearance and air bronchograms in a late preterm infant born via C-section are classic signs of RDS. The maternal history of gestational diabetes may also contribute to respiratory issues, but the imaging is the most compelling evidence here. Given the current findings and your limited history of other complications, I will proceed with this diagnosis.
